english:
To Kreupasanam Mother and her Holy Son, a thousand thanks. We have come here to express our gratitude to Mother Mary and Jesus for the miraculous testimony given to us.
We are parish members from the Kanjirappally Diocese. My name is Elizabeth Jose and my husband’s name is Abhilash.
Even after 16 years of marriage, we did not have children. We underwent many treatments, but nothing worked. In 2019, I became pregnant once, but it went as a miscarriage without a heartbeat.
Then COVID came. After that, we did not continue any treatment. We were fully disappointed, age was moving ahead, and we were deeply troubled. Even after praying and praying, we were not getting a child — it was a great sorrow.
At that time, my friend came here and made a Covenant, and she told me about the miracles of the Blessed Salt and the Covenant Oil,
She said, “Go and listen to the testimonies there. So many miracles are happening! Even elderly people are getting children. If you go there once, it will be good for you.” So in 2023,
I was able to come here and make a Covenant.
On July 17, 2024, I came to know that I was pregnant. We went to Pala Medicity Hospital, and there were many problems — age-related issues, high BP, high sugar,
There were many complications. We had to go to the hospital every two or three days.
I prayed to Mother Mary like this: “Mother, this is a child for whom we waited not five or ten years but 16 long years. If you want me to have this child, please give us a perfectly healthy child.”
“Or else take it this moment itself’” That was my prayer. For the seventh-month scan and an injection,
on January 6th, we went to the hospital. After the scan, they asked us to get admitted there. So, we got admitted.
On January 17th early morning, suddenly my sugar level dropped and when they checked the baby’s heartbeat, it was falling very low. The doctor immediately called my husband and said,
“We need to do a C-section urgently and take the baby out, otherwise it will become risky.” So, at seven months completed — at 32 weeks — they took the baby out through operation.
The baby stayed 38 days in NICU and we were totally 56 days admitted in the hospital.
We received a baby weighing just 1 kg 387 grams. When I saw him, I was very sad, crying badly — “God, this is not the kind of child I desired.
You did not give me a good and healthy baby,” thinking like this, I cried so much. But still,
we held tightly onto Mother Mary. Wherever I went, I carried the blessed medal of Mother Mary — for scans and everywhere, I only went with that medal. “Mother,
be with us always, let there be no problems.” I always applied the Covenant oil and used the covenant items. Like that,
Mother Mary blessed us with a perfectly healthy baby. We named him Joseph. There is no problem at all now. Ten months have passed.
The one behind all this was my friend — she always insisted, “You have no work at home, right? Just go, just go,” and she kept pushing me.
That is how I came here, and through Mother Mary we received this baby. Mother Mary blessed everything. To Mother Mary, thousand of thanks!
This girl is 40 years old and Abhilash is 45 years old — and at this age, God gave them this child. My name is Marykutty Mathew.
I am coming from Pala Diocese. It was on 8-2-2023 that I took the Covenant. When I took the Covenant, I had severe back pain — my spine was bent.
All the doctors told me not to do any work — only complete bed rest. At that time, I prayed to the Lord,
Then my neighbor who lived next to my house told me, “We are going to that place.” Then I said, “I will also come.” So, I came here.
Like Father use to say, I knew nothing. Nobody explained anything to me that day. But I would listen to the Father's classes without missing.
I used to do all these practices. And like that, my back pain which I had for 20 years completely got healed.
I can do all work now. Earlier I could not even kneel to pray or stand in church — nothing was possible. But now everything is possible for me.
For giving me this much, a thousand thanks to God and Mother Mary. “2 Samuel 7:29 — ‘Lord God,
may it please You to bless the household of Your servant, so that it may continue forever in Your presence. For You, Sovereign Lord, have spoken, and with Your blessing the house of Your servant will be blessed forever.’”
Sister Elizabeth Jose along with her life partner and with the sister Marykutty who brought them to Mother Mary’s holy presence to take the Covenant —
are here witnessing in front of Mother Mary this great divine blessing received in their family, a miraculous blessing.
Every Covenant life becomes pleasing in the presence of God.
Because to those who take the Covenant with desire and join wholeheartedly, God allows many miraculous openings and doors to be unlocked.
In this testimony we heard — after completing 16 years of married life, when the sister reached 40 years of age and her husband reached 45 years — by the mercy of Mother Mary and Jesus,
this family was blessed with a child, receiving the blessing of offspring. No medicine or treatment was the reason for this — it is the life of Covenant,
the hope placed in Mother Mary — what was considered impossible, God made possible for them, by placing great trust.
Uniting her life to the apparition of Mother Mary, every moment praying, “Mother, protect us, help us,” continuously holding on to the covenant items,
She kept praying to Mother Mary to give into her hands the child formed in her womb with full growth and perfect health, dear ones,
Not because of our merits, not because of our holiness, but purely because of God’s mercy upon us — when we surrender our life into God’s hands,
God asks us to walk with Him by giving even greater blessings. This is what we should always remember in a Covenant life.
Not because we are perfect that God gives us blessings, but when we give our hearts to God and decide to rely on Him,
God stands with us, does great things for us and tells us — “Stay with Me, your life will be blessed.” The sister said through her friend,
“You don’t have any other work at home, right? Why sit idle? Go to Kreupasanam. So many are getting children there,” “Many who waited long years are receiving children.
Go to Mother Mary, surrender before her, pray, take the Covenant, believe — Mother will do great things!” Like that,
Marykutty tightly held this sister’s hand and brought her here, and from the moment she met Mother Mary,
giving her life into the hands of Mother Mary — the blessing and joy of that surrender is what she is witnessing now,
after 16 years — carrying a perfectly healthy baby in her arms.
In our life too, in every life matter, we have the right to receive God’s blessings — God will allow it.
We must have the decision to give our life to God — for that, we must pray. Thanking Mother Mary and the Holy Son for the blessings received in this family,
let us clap our hands and offer this testimony.
